whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Sora House,

I noticed your rooftop cafe has a great spot in Rupaspur, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table reservations and menu exploration.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, special rooftop menu, aur timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/sorahouse

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Sora House, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke rooftop cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with a direct WhatsApp table booking feature and rooftop menu showcase for your Rupaspur location. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
